fact: The document is the text of the Statistics Act, Chapter 351 (Revised Edition 2019, originally Act No. 9 of 2015, commenced 2 November 2015 by GN 491 of 2015), which continues the National Bureau of Statistics and sets up its Governing Board and the coordination of the National Statistical System.

The document is the text of the Statistics Act, Cap. 351 (Revised Edition 2023), Act No. 9 of 2015, which continues the National Bureau of Statistics and sets up its Board; it gives its commencement as 2 November 2015.

The NBS catalogue page for the 2025 Integrated Labour Force Survey states that survey information is collected under the Statistics Act, Cap. 351, Revised Edition 2019, so the Act is treated as in force; the page gives no date of making, so the revised edition year is used.

The NBS Dissemination Policy (September 2024), signed by the Statistician General, says NBS operates as an autonomous public institution under the Ministry of Finance in accordance with the Statistics Act No. 9 of 2015 (R.E. 2019), which establishes it as Cap. 351.
